title: fix(cli): os db orphans sweeps details whose controlled-by-parent master is optional
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9EjYahUm1cF2Gdc8QN2miR)_

Fixes #30976

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os db orphans` 现在也扫描「主表可选」的子对象(`controlled_by_parent` 对象唯一的 `master_detail` 声明为 `required: false`,#30905 裁决 A 放行的写法):这类行若指向一条已不存在的主记录,会被列为孤儿(`--delete` 时先导出再随级联删除);主表字段为空的行是合法的,不列出、不删除。
- 为什么改:扫描只认 `required: true` 的主表字段(spec 的 `isControlledByParentMasterField`),PR #30940 引入可选主表后,这类悬空行既没有任何用户入口能读到(访问权从不存在的主记录派生),`os db orphans` 也看不见。
- 风险与回滚:只改 CLI 的运维命令(手动执行、默认只报告不写);删除范围只多出「可选主表且主记录确已不存在」的行,判定复用 spec 已发布的 `controlledByParentMasterOf`,不改 spec。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.ts` 的 `masterFieldsOf`(新判定,含 `sharingModel` 限定);`packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.integration.test.ts` 新夹具 `od_tip` 与改动的删除断言;`orphan-detail-sweep.test.ts` 新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/db/orphans.integration.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全绿,其中 `[#30976]` 用例证明空主表行 `t_none` 不被列出、悬空行 `t_orphan` 被列为孤儿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.ts`** — the sweep's "which field is a master" judgement moves into one local predicate, `masterFieldsOf(object)`:
  - every REQUIRED `master_detail` (`isControlledByParentMasterField`, unchanged — the CONTROL);
  - on a `controlled_by_parent` object, its OPTIONAL master: `controlledByParentMasterOf(fields)` from `@objectstack/spec/data` answering `optional: true` (the one `master_detail`, declared `required: false`, with no required one beside it). The spec function reads any field map and leaves the sharing model to the caller, so the sweep asks `sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent'` itself: only such an object derives its rows' access from that field (plugin-security's cbp read filter, `security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts`, returns no filter for any other model).
  - `objectsWithRequiredMaster` → `objectsWithMaster`, `isRequiredMasterFinding` → `isMasterFinding` (module-internal to the CLI; not on any `exports` subpath). Docblocks and the "other dangling" note no longer say "required master-detail".
- A row whose optional master is EMPTY is never a finding: the dangling-reference audit treats `null` / `undefined` / `''` as "no link" (`packages/objectql/src/integrity/dangling-reference-audit.ts`, "Empty is not a reference"), so the sweep adds no null check of its own.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.ts`** — the command's `description`, docblock and human heading said "required master-detail master"; that became false with this change, so they now say "master" (description: "Report detail rows whose master-detail reference names a master that does not exist, …").
- **`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`** — the `os db orphans` table row and section say the same, and name the optional master and the empty-master row.
- `.changeset/30976-orphans-optional-master.md` — `@objectstack/cli` patch.

No `packages/spec` edit: the optional-master judgement already exists there (`controlledByParentMasterOf`, public since PR #30940); the order's stop-line (a new spec predicate) is not reached.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.test.ts` (unit, fake read-only engine):
  - fixture gains `sw_optional` (cbp, one `master_detail` `required: false`, plus a lookup), `sw_optional_private` (the same lone optional `master_detail` on a `private` object) and `sw_required_cbp` (cbp with a required master and an optional `master_detail` beside it);
  - the existing "reads only the objects that declare a master" case now expects `sw_optional` and `sw_required_cbp` read, `sw_optional_private` not;
  - new `[#30976]` describe: `masterFieldsOf` per object (CONTROL: `sw_detail` still answers its two required masters), and a dangling optional master is an orphan while a dangling lookup on the same object and a dangling optional `master_detail` beside a required master stay in `otherDangling`, never deletable.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.integration.test.ts` (integration, real boot + SQLite): fixture gains `od_tip`, cbp with an optional master on `od_campaign`, seeded through a system write with three rows — `t_none` (no campaign), `t_live` (the live campaign), `t_orphan` (the missing campaign).
  - new case `[#30976] an optional master: …`: `t_orphan` is an orphan; `t_none` and `t_live` appear in neither `orphans` nor `otherDangling`;
  - the existing cases now carry the second orphan: the report lists `od_tip/t_orphan` (counts `orphans: 2`), `--delete` removes it and keeps `t_none` and `t_live` (`od_tip: ['t_live', 't_none']` after the run), the export holds it, and in the restrict case the unrestricted `od_tip` orphan is deleted while `od_member` is refused as before.
  - six module-top side-effect imports (`@objectstack/service-datasource`, `driver-turso`, `runtime`, `platform-objects/plugin`, `plugin-security`, `rest`) — `check:test-source-alias` asks them of an edited test file whose source reaches those dynamic imports, copying `serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- The three orphan files (`orphan-detail-sweep.test.ts`, `orphans.integration.test.ts`, `orphans.no-auto-run.test.ts`) on head `ec530681`: `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 25 passed (25)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` on `0967087c` (the `origin/main` merge; `ec530681` only adds the six imports to the integration file): `Test Files 2 failed | 396 passed (398) · Tests 5595 passed | 29 skipped`. The two files were `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` and `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`, refusing "packages/cli is not built (./dist/index.js is absent)"; after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` both ran: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 29 passed (29)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- The integration layer is run here because the diff edits an integration-tier file; the rest of that layer is CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (both restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

1. **The optional-master arm** — `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.ts --anchor 'if (master?.optional === true) out.push(master.field);' --delete` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7e854c86` → `766c6ecb`), running the unit file and the integration file: **8 failed | 10 passed (18)**. Red: the three unit cases above, e.g. `AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ { object: 'sw_optional', …(3) } ]`, and five integration cases, e.g. `[#30976] an optional master: …` `AssertionError: expected [ 'od_member', 'od_member_note', …(1) ] to include 'od_tip'` and the report case `expected [ { object: 'od_member', …(3) } ] to deeply equal [ { object: 'od_member', …(3) }, …(1) ]`. The CONTROL case ("an orphan is a dangling REQUIRED master-detail …") stayed green under the ablation.
2. **The `controlled_by_parent` limit** (negative pin: a lone optional `master_detail` on a `private` object is not a master) — anchor `if (def?.sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent') {` replaced by `if (def !== undefined || def?.sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent') {` (blob `7e854c86` → `9bc35e09`), unit file: **2 failed | 6 passed (8)** — `expected [ 'master' ] to deeply equal []` for `sw_optional_private`, and the objects list with one extra entry.

The CLI suites resolve `orphan-detail-sweep.ts` and `orphans.ts` from `src/` (relative imports), so no build leg was needed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise measured, holds.** On `origin/main` `658d84f5`, `isControlledByParentMasterField` (`packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`) answers `type === 'master_detail' && required === true` only; PR #30940 left it a required-master predicate and added `controlledByParentMasterOf` beside it for the optional master. The sweep called only the former.
- **Deleting an optional-master orphan is the master-detail's own semantics**, which is what the #24964 ruling (record 6303808312) set as the remedy: a `master_detail` cascades or restricts (`deleteBehavior: 'set_null'` on it is a parse-time refusal, `field.zod.ts`), so the master's own delete would have removed such a row or been refused while it stood. Nulling the reference instead would be a different remedy and is not offered.
- **Not widened:** a lone `required: false` `master_detail` on a non-cbp object, and one beside a required master on a cbp object, stay "other dangling" — named, never deleted. A row with an empty optional master is never read as an orphan.
- **Surface beyond the order's expected surface** (`orphan-detail-sweep.ts` + its test): `orphans.ts` text, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, and `orphans.integration.test.ts`. The first two said "required master-detail master", which this change makes false; the integration file is the only place the null-master half can fail for real (the unit file's audit is a fake, and the audit is what skips empty values). Declared in the report.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (92 families for this diff, the same list at `0967087c` and `ec530681`), run on head **`ec530681`**, each exit code captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`:

- **92 run, exit 0 each.** `--ran`: "92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 92 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- Prerequisites built first: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build` (VERDICT command-exit 0), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, and the build closure `check:i18n-coverage` names plus `@objectstack/client` / `@objectstack/client-react` for `check:skill-examples` (turbo, VERDICT command-exit 0). `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` for its pinned fixture on this shallow clone.
- The first round, on `0967087c`, answered `check:test-source-alias` exit 1 — the edited integration file reached six dynamic imports with no module-top load — fixed in `ec530681` (the six imports above), then exit 0; and four exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (the three above plus `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which on the second round found enough built `dist/` to measure: "116 published require entry point(s) across 71 package(s) load").
- CI families (every required check) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

`pnpm lint` scoped: `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/cli --no-inline-config`, exit 0 (the package has no `lint` script); re-run on the edited integration file at `ec530681`, exit 0.

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` (two module-internal renames): exit 0, "0 anchored files in the change set".
